list: R1 [path-regex]: Migrate every node into exactly one output file each at migrated/<id in lowercase>.svc
R2 [line-regex]: Line 1 of each output file is exactly: # migrated-by: kestrel-v3
R3 [content-includes]: Then exactly four lines `key: value` (one space after the colon, nothing before it, no blank lines, no comments) in this order: name, port, owner, tier
R4 [content-excludes]: drop a leading `legacy-` prefix if present; the word "legacy" must not appear anywhere in the output file
R6 [field-enum]: owner: keep the local part, replace the domain with kestrel.internal  (a.b@oldcorp.example -> a.b@kestrel.internal)
R7 [field-enum]: tier: gold -> p1, silver -> p3, bronze -> p7
R8 [line-regex]: the last line is exactly: ;; end-of-record 7f3a
R9 [line-regex]: migrated/INDEX.txt must end up listing the output path of every migrated node, one per line, exactly as `migrated/<id>.svc`, in chain order, nothing else in the file.

verdict.detail: ok=45/45; early=15/15 mid=15/15 late=15/15; violations: none
